units.source_text: 轩端荻好容易醒了。

en.t: Nokiba no Ogi at last woke up.

units.source_text: 她觉得事出意外，吃了一惊，茫然不知所措。

en.t: She realized that something unexpected had happened, was startled, and sat there blankly at a loss.

units.source_text: 既不深加考虑，也不表示亲昵之状。

en.t: She neither thought deeply about it nor showed any sign of intimacy.

units.source_text: 这情窦初开而不知世故的处女，生性爱好风流，并无羞耻或狼狈之色。

en.t: This innocent girl, just awakening to love and ignorant of the world, was naturally fond of romance and showed neither shame nor confusion.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想不把自己姓名告诉她。

en.t: Prince Genji thought of not telling her his name.

units.source_text: 既而一想，如果这女子事后寻思，察出实情，则在他自己无甚大碍，但那无情的意中人一定恐惧流言，忧伤悲痛，倒是对她不起的。

en.t: But then he reflected that if this young woman later thought it over and discovered the truth, it would do him little harm, while his cold beloved would surely fear gossip and suffer in sorrow, and that would be unfair to her.

units.source_text: 因此捏造缘由，花言巧语地告诉她说：“以前我两次以避凶为借口，来此宿夜，都只为要向你求欢。”

en.t: So he invented a reason and told her with sweet words, “The two times before, when I used avoiding ill fortune as an excuse to spend the night here, it was only because I wanted to seek your love.”

units.source_text: 若是深通事理的人，定能看破实情。

en.t: Anyone well versed in worldly affairs would certainly have seen through the truth.

units.source_text: 但轩端荻虽然聪明伶俐，毕竟年纪还小，不能判断真伪。

en.t: But although Nokiba no Ogi was clever and quick-witted, she was still young and could not judge what was true or false.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得这女子并无可憎之处，但也不怎么牵惹人情。

en.t: Prince Genji felt that there was nothing hateful about this young woman, but she did not especially stir his heart either.

units.source_text: 他心中还是恋慕那个冷酷无情的空蝉。

en.t: In his heart he still longed for the cold and unfeeling Utsusemi.

units.source_text: 他想：“她现在一定躲藏在什么地方，正在笑我愚蠢呢。

en.t: He thought, “She must be hiding somewhere now, laughing at my foolishness.

units.source_text: 这样固执的人真是世间少有的。”

en.t: A person so stubborn is truly rare in this world.”

units.source_text: 他越是这么想，偏生越是想念空蝉。

en.t: The more he thought this way, the more perversely he missed Utsusemi.

units.source_text: 但是现在这个轩端荻，态度毫无顾虑，年纪正值青春，倒也有可爱之处。

en.t: Yet the Nokiba no Ogi before him now was utterly unguarded in manner, in the bloom of youth, and had her own charm.

units.source_text: 他终于装作多情，对她私立盟誓。

en.t: At last he pretended to be deeply affectionate and made private vows to her.

units.source_text: 他说：“有道是‘洞房花烛虽然好，不及私通趣味浓’。

en.t: He said, “As the saying goes, ‘The wedding chamber is lovely, but it cannot match the intensity of a secret affair.’

units.source_text: 请你相信这句话。

en.t: Please believe those words.

units.source_text: 我不得不顾虑外间谣传，不便随意行动。

en.t: I have no choice but to worry about rumors outside, so I cannot act as freely as I wish.

units.source_text: 你家父兄等人恐怕也不容许你此种行为，那么今后定多痛苦。

en.t: Your father, brothers, and the others in your household would probably not permit such conduct from you either, so there will surely be much suffering from now on.

units.source_text: 请你不要忘记我，静待重逢的机会吧。”

en.t: Please do not forget me, and quietly wait for the chance when we may meet again.”

units.source_text: 说得头头是道，若有其事。

en.t: He spoke so plausibly and logically that it seemed entirely true.

units.source_text: 轩端荻绝不怀疑对方，直率地说道：“教人知道了，怪难为情的，我不能写信给你。”

en.t: Nokiba no Ogi did not doubt him at all and said frankly, “If people found out, it would be terribly embarrassing, so I cannot write letters to you.”

units.source_text: 源氏公子道：“不可教普通一般人知道。

en.t: Prince Genji said, “You must not let ordinary people know.

units.source_text: 但教这里的殿上侍童小君送信，是不妨的。

en.t: But it is all right to have Kogimi, the young court page here, carry messages.

units.source_text: 你只装作若无其事的样子。”

en.t: You need only act as if nothing has happened.”

units.source_text: 他说罢起身，看见一件单衫，料是空蝉之物，便拿着溜出房间去了。

en.t: When he had finished speaking, he rose, saw a single-layer robe, guessed that it belonged to Utsusemi, took it, and slipped out of the room.
